title: 雜阿含經  卷第十  六入處相應  （237）  毗舍離
chinese_text:
如是我聞：

一時，佛住毘舍離獼猴池側重閣講堂。

時，有長者名郁瞿婁，往詣佛所，稽首佛足，退坐一面，白佛言：「世尊！何故有一比丘見法般涅槃？何故比丘不得見法般涅槃？」

佛告長者：「若有比丘眼識於色，愛念染著，以愛念染著故，常依於識；為彼縛故，若彼取故，不得見法般涅槃。耳、鼻、舌、身、意識法亦復如是。

「若比丘眼識於色，不愛樂染著，不愛樂染著者，不依於識，不觸、不著、不取故，此諸比丘得見法般涅槃。耳、鼻、舌、身、意識法亦復如是。

「是故，長者！有比丘得見法般涅槃者，有不得見法般涅槃者。」

如長者所問經，如是阿難所問經及佛自為諸比丘所說經，亦如上說。
pali_text: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate. Atha kho sakko devānamindo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṁ ṭhito kho sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena m’idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti? Ko pana, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena m’idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantī”ti? “Santi kho, devānaminda, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṁhitā rajanīyā. Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati. Tassa taṁ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato tannissitaṁ viññāṇaṁ hoti tadupādānaṁ. Saupādāno, devānaminda, bhikkhu no parinibbāyati …pe…. Santi kho, devānaminda, jivhāviññeyyā rasā …pe… santi kho, devānaminda, manoviññeyyā dhammā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṁhitā rajanīyā. Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati. Tassa taṁ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato tannissitaṁ viññāṇaṁ hoti tadupādānaṁ. Saupādāno, devānaminda, bhikkhu no parinibbāyati. Ayaṁ kho, devānaminda, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo yena m’idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti. Santi ca kho, devānaminda, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṁhitā rajanīyā. Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati. Tassa taṁ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato na tannissitaṁ viññāṇaṁ hoti, na tadupādānaṁ. Anupādāno, devānaminda, bhikkhu parinibbāyati …pe…. Santi kho, devānaminda, jivhāviññeyyā rasā …pe… santi kho, devānaminda, manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṁhitā rajanīyā. Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati. Tassa taṁ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato na tannissitaṁ viññāṇaṁ hoti na tadupādānaṁ. Anupādāno, devānaminda, bhikkhu parinibbāyati. Ayaṁ kho, devānaminda, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo yena m’idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantī”ti. Pañcamaṁ.
english_sn_text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha, on the Vulture’s Peak Mountain. And then Sakka, lord of gods, went up to the Buddha, bowed, stood to one side, and said to him: “What is the cause, sir, what is the reason why some sentient beings are not fully extinguished in this very life? What is the cause, what is the reason why some sentient beings are fully extinguished in this very life?” “Lord of gods, there are sights known by the eye, which are likable, desirable, agreeable, pleasant, sensual, and arousing. If a mendicant approves, welcomes, and keeps clinging to them, their consciousness has that as support and fuel for grasping. A mendicant with fuel for grasping does not become extinguished. There are sounds … smells … tastes … touches … ideas known by the mind, which are likable, desirable, agreeable, pleasant, sensual, and arousing. If a mendicant approves, welcomes, and keeps clinging to them, their consciousness has that as support and fuel for grasping. A mendicant with fuel for grasping does not become extinguished. That’s the cause, that’s the reason why some sentient beings are not fully extinguished in this very life. There are sights known by the eye, which are likable, desirable, agreeable, pleasant, sensual, and arousing. If a mendicant doesn’t approve, welcome, and keep clinging to them, their consciousness doesn’t have that as support and fuel for grasping. A mendicant free of grasping becomes extinguished. There are sounds … smells … tastes … touches … ideas known by the mind, which are likable, desirable, agreeable, pleasant, sensual, and arousing. If a mendicant doesn’t approve, welcome, and keep clinging to them, their consciousness doesn’t have that as support and fuel for grasping. A mendicant free of grasping becomes extinguished. That’s the cause, that’s the reason why some sentient beings are fully extinguished in this very life.”

kumarajiva_style_text:
如是我闻：一时佛在毗舍离猕猴池侧重阁讲堂。
时有长者名郁瞿娄，来诣佛所，稽首礼足，退坐一面，白佛言：世尊，何故有比丘得见法般涅槃？何故有比丘不得？
佛告长者：若比丘眼识于色，爱念染著，依识而住，为缚为取，则不得见法般涅槃。耳、鼻、舌、身、意亦复如是。
若眼识于色，不爱不染，不依于识，不触不著不取，则得见法般涅槃。耳、鼻、舌、身、意亦复如是。
是故，长者，有得见法般涅槃者，有不得者。
（省文）如长者所问，阿难所问及佛自为诸比丘说，亦如上说。
modern_psychology_text:
我是这样听说的：有一次，佛住在毗舍离猕猴池旁的重阁讲堂。
那时，有一位名叫郁瞿娄的长者来到佛前，头面礼足，退坐一面，对佛说：世尊，为什么有的比丘能见法般涅槃？为什么有的不能？
佛告诉长者：若比丘对眼所识的色爱念染著，识依彼而住，被系缚、被执取，就不能见法般涅槃。耳、鼻、舌、身、意也是一样。
若对眼所识的色不爱不染，识不依彼，不触、不著、不取，就能见法般涅槃。耳、鼻、舌、身、意也是一样。
所以，长者，有的能见法般涅槃，有的不能。
（以下是原典的省文指示）如同这部是长者所问，同样还有阿难所问，以及佛亲自为比丘们所说，义理都如上。
notes: 本经 SC 平行表所列平行及 `raw_aligned_data.json` 内之巴利本文、Sujato 英译并用以厘定法义；求那跋陀罗汉本用于定位经文与传统术语。Anālayo 之 SA 英译（DDJBS 18, 2016）止于 SA 229，本批无其逐经英译。confidence=medium：SC 所列 SN35.118（Sakka）设于灵鹫山、问者为释提桓因，而本经设于毗舍离、问者为长者郁瞿娄；法说段（可爱色等之喜、迎、染著→识有彼所依、有取→不般涅槃；反之则般涅槃）与巴利可对，然框式与所对之众全异，依规约降为 medium，存汉本而志平行之异。「见法般涅槃」＝ diṭṭhadhamma parinibbāna（于现法般涅槃）。「依识而住」＝ tannissitaṁ viññāṇaṁ hoti tadupādānaṁ（识依彼、有彼之取）。雅：压缩「爱念染著故常依于识」之求那体。末段省文如实存，不伪作全文。
